Our Mission

Making Real Estate Buying Honest, Simple, and Rewarding

In a market often plagued by opacity, GS Associations was built on a radical idea: what if real estate advisors truly worked for buyers, not just commissions? That principle drives everything we do.

We invest in technology, training, and data to ensure every client gets accurate information, fair pricing, and a partner who's with them long after the keys are handed over.

RERA compliance expertise
In-house legal verification
Zero hidden charges
Lifetime advisory support
Bank-approved properties only

Our Journey

12 Years of Building Trust

2012

GS Associations founded in Hyderabad with a team of 5 advisors

2015

Expanded to 3 offices across Hyderabad. Crossed ₹100 Crore in transactions

2018

Launched GS Loan Advisory — partnered with 10 leading banks

2020

Digital transformation. First real estate portal in Hyderabad with live tracking

2022

Crossed 1,000 successfully closed transactions. Team grew to 80+ professionals

2024

Launched GS Associations 2.0 — AI-powered property matching and lead tracking
